//: The security policy in one place (openspec change react-typescript, task 3.1; design D15): build.py reads it to write _headers, and the Worker imports it to set the same headers on the pages it renders (task 2.4). thirdParties is the one list of hosts outside this site that a page or worker may reach (learnvedicmath design D10): a page's Content-Security-Policy is built from it, the build fails when a published file names a host that is in neither this list nor LINKS in build.py, and e2e fails on a request to a host not here. csp maps a directive to the pages that allow the host there ('play' is the game only, '*' every page); an empty csp means no page contacts it (only a worker). The Firebase hosts come from js/cloud-config.js (build.py firebase_sources). directives is the policy in order: sources every page gets, 'play' the game's extra sources, 'hashes' where the page's inline script hashes go, 'enforced' sources only the enforced policy has, 'only' a directive that is in one of the two policies, 'none' the value when nothing is allowed. headers are sent on every response.
